formal_scope: REFERENCE_ONLY until official data/checkpoint/raw outputs and native-input compatibility are demonstrated
scope: P20-C official HCP audit only; no training, no P1i adapter, no test/sealed access

official.paper: Hard Constraint Projection Enhanced Neural Operator with Hybrid Sampling for Chiplet System Thermal Analysis

official_requirements_highlights: python stack pins NumPy 1.24.3 and PyTorch 2.0.0 with CUDA 11.x packages

upstream_method_contract.method: DeepONet with hard constraint projection (HCP) and hybrid structured-mesh plus Latin-hypercube sampling
upstream_method_contract.physics: PDE residual plus boundary/interface treatment; HCP enforces boundary values through projection
upstream_method_contract.geometry_representation: inline structured cuboidal domains with explicit starts/ends/num_intervals
upstream_method_contract.mesh_requirement: uniform structured 3D mesh; projection code rejects a nonuniform or incomplete full grid
upstream_method_contract.source_representation: inline volumetric power maps with grid-index locations and scalar values
upstream_method_contract.bc_representation: inline per-face adiabatic/HTC/interface declarations; one parameterized bottom HTC in the official single-HTC script
upstream_method_contract.material_representation: conductivity distribution is configured per domain; official example uses fixed background conductivity and fixed k values
upstream_method_contract.training_device: single CUDA GPU recommended by README
upstream_method_contract.checkpoint_contract: eval.py loads model_epoch_<epoch>.pth; trained checkpoints/raw outputs are not committed and are available on request

p1i_compatibility.p1i_input: variable geometry/material/source/dual-Robin BC encoded at irregular 1024 support points
reason: official scripts define geometry, power maps and BC inline rather than consume a per-case P1i tensor
HCP projection requires a complete uniform structured grid
no official P1i variable-geometry/material/source/BC loader or checkpoint was found
p1i_compatibility.recommended_path: HCP native benchmark plus separately scoped Heat3D same-domain adaptation, only after assets are obtained

asset_audit.readme_note: README states trained checkpoints and raw experiment outputs (~326 MB of NPZ/NPY/PTH files and figures) are not included and are available on request

decision_and_next_action.minimum_next_step: Obtain official benchmark data, checkpoint and raw-output bundle; reproduce one native single-HTC evaluation in an isolated environment before considering any P1i mapping
decision_and_next_action.failure_scope: HCP only; does not block Therm-FM or existing G2 common-task evidence
